powershell:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'
$taskSource='D:\Noetome\target\b06u-t02-source-20261105'
$taskRelease=Join-Path $taskSource 'target\release'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $taskRelease -Force | Out-Null
Copy-Item -LiteralPath 'D:\Noetome\target\release\noetome-desktop.exe' -Destination $taskRelease
$taskInstalled=Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Programs\Noetome\noetome-desktop.exe'
$taskOldHash=(Get-FileHash $taskInstalled -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
$taskExisting=@(Get-Process noetome-desktop -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Path -eq $taskInstalled })
@{old_sha256=$taskOldHash;stopped_processes=@($taskExisting | Select-Object Id,Path)} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4 | Set-Content (Join-Path $taskSource 'before-install.json') -Encoding utf8
foreach ($taskProcess in $taskExisting) { Stop-Process -Id $taskProcess.Id -ErrorAction Stop }
if ($taskOldHash.ToLowerInvariant() -ne 'c54f17f014c31d1c435896936e7a538d7d625d206c41d510a7c1bb62615c1fe0') { throw 'Existing app differs from last verified installation' }
$taskInstallDir=Split-Path $taskInstalled -Parent
$taskNames=@(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $taskInstallDir | ForEach-Object {$_.Name})
if ($taskNames.Count -ne 2 -or $taskNames -notcontains 'noetome-desktop.exe' -or $taskNames -notcontains 'uninstall.exe') { throw 'Unexpected files in installation directory' }
$taskBackup=Join-Path (Split-Path $taskInstallDir -Parent) 'Noetome.backup-b06u-t02-20261105'
if (Test-Path $taskBackup) { throw 'Backup path already exists' }
Move-Item -LiteralPath $taskInstallDir -Destination $taskBackup
& (Join-Path $taskSource 'scripts\install_desktop.ps1') -InstallerPath 'D:\Noetome\target\release\bundle\nsis\Noetome_0.1.0_x64-setup.exe' -OutputDir 'C:\Users\Lyinn\AppData\Local\NoetomeBuilds\windows-b06u-t02'
